title: Welantin
shortDescription: A full-featured e-commerce platform with product management.
description: An inventory management system for CV companies in freelance projects, simplifying stock management.
fullDescription: This e-commerce platform provides businesses with a complete solution for selling products online. Built with C++ and Qt for high performance and cross-platform compatibility. Features include a responsive design, product catalog with filtering and search capabilities, shopping cart functionality, secure checkout integration, user authentication, and an admin dashboard for managing products, orders, and customers.

title: Iniitu
shortDescription: An invoice creation application for UMKM(MSMEs) in freelance projects, enabling easier invoice recording and management.
description: A collaborative task management application with real-time updates and team workspaces.
fullDescription: This task management system helps teams organize and track their work efficiently. Built with Java Spring Boot for the backend and React for the frontend, it provides robust task management capabilities. Features include task creation and assignment, due dates and reminders, progress tracking, file attachments, comments and discussions, team workspaces, and real-time updates.

title: SPACE - Venturo
shortDescription: A project management system for Agile development that helps teams efficiently plan and track project progress.
description: A comprehensive system monitoring tool with real-time analytics and performance tracking.
fullDescription: This system resource monitor provides real-time insights into system performance. Built primarily in C++ with Python for data analysis, it offers comprehensive monitoring capabilities. The application tracks CPU usage, memory consumption, network traffic, and disk operations, providing detailed analytics and alerts for system administrators.

title: Timebox - Venturo
shortDescription: An application like a To-Do List designed to enhance productivity by allocating time for each task.
description: A custom programming language compiler with advanced optimization features.
fullDescription: This compiler project implements a custom programming language with modern features and optimizations. Built using C and LLVM, it includes comprehensive error handling and code optimization capabilities. The compiler performs lexical analysis, syntax parsing, semantic analysis, and generates optimized assembly code.

title: Kelas - Venturo
shortDescription: A training platform for new employees to understand the schemes and processes applicable at the office.
description: A distributed database system with high availability and fault tolerance.
fullDescription: This distributed database system provides high availability and fault tolerance for large-scale applications. Built with C++ and Rust for performance, it implements advanced features such as data replication, sharding, and automatic failover. The system includes comprehensive monitoring and management tools.

title: Sislatkernas - KOMINFO
shortDescription: A specialized government platform for automated document creation and comprehensive auditing for KOMINFO.
description: Sistem informasi pengelolaan dan audit dokumen digital untuk Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika.
fullDescription: Sislatkernas is a mission-critical platform developed for KOMINFO (Ministry of Communication and Information Technology). It is designed to streamline the national work governance by providing tools for structured document creation and rigorous auditing. The system allows users to generate official materials and conduct thorough audits on them to ensure compliance with governmental standards, providing a complete digital trail for transparency and accountability.

title: Masjid Dana
shortDescription: A specialized fund management platform for mosques with transparent financial reporting.
description: A comprehensive financial management system tailored for mosque operations and donations.
fullDescription: Masjid Dana is a dedicated financial management platform designed to bring transparency and efficiency to mosque operations. It enables mosque administrators to accurately track donations, manage operational expenses, and generate real-time financial reports for the community. With specialized modules for Zakat, Waqf, and general alms, Masjid Dana ensures that every cent is accounted for and publicly verifiable, fostering trust within the congregation.

title: AGJKAS
shortDescription: A comprehensive personal financial manager for tracking income, expenses, and debt obligations.
description: A powerful financial recording application to manage installments, debts, and daily cash flow.
fullDescription: AGJKAS is a robust financial management application designed to help individuals and small businesses stay organized. It provides a structured platform for recording daily cash flow while offering specialized tools for tracking installments, debts, and receivables. With automated calculations and detailed reporting, AGJKAS helps users maintain a clear overview of their financial health and ensures all financial obligations are managed efficiently.

title: AGJ Split Bill Food Order Online
shortDescription: A platform for splitting food order costs online via apps like ShopeeFood, GoFood, or GrabFood.
description: A web application that simplifies bill-splitting when ordering food online with friends or groups.
fullDescription: AGJ Split Bill is a web app that helps users fairly split food order costs from services like ShopeeFood, GoFood, and GrabFood. It supports splitting by person or item, with automatic calculations, payment integration, and transaction history.

title: Urunan
shortDescription: A fair and easy bill-splitting application for group activities and travel.
description: Hitung urunan perjalanan dan kegiatan bersama dengan mudah, adil, dan transparan.
fullDescription: Urunan is a collaborative expense management tool designed to simplify the process of splitting bills among friends, family, or colleagues. Whether it's a group trip, dinner out, or shared household expenses, Urunan allows users to input participants and expenses, automatically calculates the most efficient payment paths to minimize transactions, and provides a shareable summary for everyone involved. It ensures that shared costs are divided fairly and transparently with a modern and intuitive interface.

title: Muat Trans
shortDescription: A specialized logistics e-commerce platform for spare parts and fleet management.
description: An integrated platform for selling automotive spare parts and monitoring fleet shipments.
fullDescription: Muat Trans is a comprehensive e-commerce and logistics platform tailored for the automotive and transportation industry. It combines a robust marketplace for spare parts with advanced fleet management tools, allowing users to track shipments, monitor driver assignments, and manage orders in real-time. Inspired by major logistics platforms, it provides a seamless end-to-end solution for transport businesses and suppliers.

title: POS System
shortDescription: A high-performance point-of-sale solution built for speed and reliability using Next.js and Laravel.
description: A modern cashier application designed to streamline retail transactions and inventory management.
fullDescription: A modern, full-stack point-of-sale application designed to streamline retail operations. Leveraging the power of Next.js for a lightning-fast frontend and Laravel for a robust, secure backend API, this system offers real-time transaction management, automated reporting, and seamless inventory tracking with a focus on user experience and data integrity.

title: Smart Antam - Audit App
shortDescription: A specialized digital audit platform for industrial and mining operations at PT Antam.
description: A comprehensive digital auditing solution designed to streamline mining and industrial audit processes.
fullDescription: Smart Antam is a comprehensive digital auditing solution designed for mining and industrial operations. It streamlines the audit process by providing automated checklists, real-time data collection, and robust reporting tools. The platform ensures compliance with safety and operational standards while providing clear insights for management through an intuitive dashboard, significantly reducing the time required for manual audit procedures.

title: Bank Neo - Audit App
shortDescription: A secure financial auditing system for modern banking compliance and verification.
description: A secure, high-performance auditing platform tailored for the banking industry regulatory requirements.
fullDescription: Bank Neo Audit App is a secure, high-performance auditing platform tailored for the banking industry. It provides a structured framework for conducting internal and external audits, ensuring all financial processes adhere to regulatory requirements. Features include automated verification workflows, secure document handling, and comprehensive audit trails for full transparency and accountability in financial reporting.
